reason: Expert provides a troubleshooting procedure for when traffic counters remain zero after an SFP replacement on older devices.

knowledge.summary: On older transmission devices, traffic forwarding can get stuck after replacing the optic, leaving traffic counters at zero even though the link is up; bounce the interface instead of replacing the SFP again or rebooting the unit.
knowledge.author: Erkki Expert
knowledge.details: Forwarding gets stuck after SFP replacement on older units.
